subject: EverGrid CAIQ intake — scheduling, pre-call packet, and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Alex Miller <alex.miller@evergrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@evergrid.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intake request: CAIQ walkthrough + evidence cadence for EverGrid

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — we're ready to kick off the CAIQ/SIG intake for EverGrid. Scope: CAIQ baseline + a short SOC 2 context call (we won't do a full audit now, just make sure we understand retention, logging, and encryption controls).

Can we schedule a 45-minute intake this week or early next? Here are windows that work for us (PDT):
- Wed 8/19: 09:30–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Thu 8/20: 10:00–12:00

Pre-call ask: if you can share a prefilled CAIQ (or a template) and a current network diagram/architecture PDF before the call, that will help us triage questions. Also please confirm: log retention windows (app & auth logs), whether audit logs are exportable, and whether you support regional data residency for EU/US.

I'll loop procurement once we confirm timing — they usually want a DocuSign scope + SOW after intake.

Thanks,
Alex Miller
Security Lead, EverGrid
alex.miller@evergrid.com

Attachment: EverGrid_CAQ_request.xlsx (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Miller <alex.miller@evergrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intake request: CAIQ walkthrough + evidence cadence for EverGrid

Hi Alex — great to meet you; thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely run a CAIQ intake + SOC 2 context call. Suggested: 45 minutes for intake + 15 minutes of follow-up buffer. From our side the following slots are available (PDT):
- Wed 8/19: 09:30–10:30 (works)
- Thu 8/20: 10:00–11:00 (preferred)

Pre-call packet: attached is a prefiller (redwood_caiq-prefill.xlsx) and a short artifact checklist to speed things up. On the call we'll cover: identity & access, logging & retention, encryption keys (KMS/HSM), private deployment options, and any compliance/regulatory constraints you have.

Quick answers to your pre-asks:
- Log retention: default app/auth logs 90 days; we can provide 365-day exports on request for enterprise plans.
- Audit logs: yes — exportable via our Console logging export (S3/Cloud Storage).
- Data residency: hosted regions in US and EU; private deployments available for stricter residency.

I've cc'd Kimberly (controls lead) and Olga (engineering lead) who will own artifacts and sample logs. Can each of you confirm owners for the following before the call?
- Architecture/network diagram (Olga)
- Prefilled CAIQ answers (Kimberly)
- Log sample extraction (Olga)

Attachments: redwood_caiq-prefill.xlsx; redwood-intake-checklist.pdf

Next steps: Alex — confirm Thu 8/20 10:00 PDT and we'll send a calendar invite + drive folder for artifact upload.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
